messages:
elena: Quick draft of release blurb for 'Adaptive Routing + Fallbacks' ready. Posting below, please quick QA + link checks. (docs PR #4821)
elena: Draft: "Adaptive routing lets requests route by latency/cost; automatic fallback to compatible models during capacity constraints. Includes routing policies and canary rollouts. Known issue: small regressions in reranking scores when using quantized variants on short inputs; see known issues link." Need tighter wording.
matt: sgtm. Can we add a one-line code sample for the python SDK? 3 lines max.
kevin: I'll run a link check. Which model names are we referencing? 'redwood/kitefish-v1'?
elena: yes. proposed snippet: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(model='redwood/kitefish-v1', input='Hello')
print(resp.text)
``` please shorten if too long.
samir: nit: avoid singular 'automatic fallback' -> use 'automatic fallbacks'. Also call out the rollback policy for canaries.
matt: also we need to call out embeddings streaming deprecation in the whatsnew and link to the migration guide.
elena: good catch — will add link to /docs/migrations/embeddings-streaming-deprecation and the migration checklist.
docs-bot: Reminder: PR must include a changelog entry and update SDK samples under /docs/sdk/python/generate.md per style guide.
kevin: Link check: found a broken anchor in the kv-caching section (docs/runtime/caching#prefix-kv). I'll open a small fix PR.
elena: Thanks — can someone smoke-test the snippet and confirm the returned object shape? tagging @matt @samir
matt: ran snippet locally, works but note when streaming is enabled the return may be an iterator/generator. Recommend showing `.text` or `.choices[0].text` explicitly to avoid confusion.
samir: I'll draft a quick migration note about quantized-model behavior and add it to Known Issues with short repro.
elena: timeline: want final copy by EOD today and PR by tomorrow 10:00 UTC. If no objections I'll push the draft to the relnotes branch. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Publish window scheduled for 2026-03-25 15:00 UTC if PR merges before 14:30 UTC.
kevin: pushed linkfix PR #4832 for the kv-caching anchor.
matt: LGTM on copy after tiny grammar tweak: change "preserve latency SLOs" -> "meet latency SLOs".
elena: applied edits and opened docs PR #4835. tagging reviewers @matt @kevin @samir. Thanks everyone!
